about: The first region's store, version 2 (AI-written, 11 November 2026). A question is one distinction a law draws, asked of a relation among a small cast; an answer is a plain predicate anchored to the Lean predicates and ledger premises that state it; a place is a name for a set of answers; a law is one row on one question. Nothing here is a result.

cast.ask: What does the choosing go by?
Whom does the rule now favour?
What does going on draw on that the rule does not count?
Who depends on what is used up?

ask.en: Where does the rule come from?

answers.test: What comes next depends on the rule and not on who is ahead; the rule is not rebuilt from what it picked.
The rule read is a monotone function of who is ahead (the share, the tally, the pool of its makers): more ahead, a rule no less favouring.
The rule read falls as those ahead grow: the reading is monotone into the reversed order.

ask.en: Does the rule keep ahead whoever is ahead?
ask.zh: 规则是不是让领先的一直领先？

answers.test: The rule in force does not favour those ahead, or is above what the rebuilding gives; includes swinging without end. It says nothing of the other side being held.

say.en: held for the side it picked

answers.test: Locked: the rule in force favours those ahead and is not above what the reading gives; neither falls from then on.
Locked under the reversed order: the same hold, for those who were not ahead. The same questions can be asked of it again.

ask.en: How many ways are in use in the group?
ask.zh: 这群人里有几种做法在用？

answers.test: Members hold different forms, words or kinds for the same thing, or not everyone has come to one.
Every member of the group holds the same one (agreement of all; a kind every member carries).

ask.en: Which is more: what a costly practice brings back to its doers, or what it costs them?
ask.zh: 一件费力的事，做的人得回来的多，还是花掉的多？

say.en: it brings back less than it costs

answers.test: What comes back to the doers alone is below the cost; whatever comes to everyone alike does not count.

say.en: it brings back at least what it costs

answers.test: What comes back to the doers alone covers the cost.

ask.en: Who has a say in how the rule is judged?

answers.test: The way the rule is read is itself formed from who is ahead; a change of judging alone is undone at the next rebuilding.
The measure is taken only over those the course has left standing.
The rule is the pool of its makers' judgments, both kinds among them, each kind judging for its own.

say.en: a list fixed at the start

answers.test: The measure is taken over a fixed list of all who began, whoever is left.

ask.en: Is something used up that the rule does not count?
ask.zh: 有没有规则不算的东西在被耗掉？

answers.test: The law's statement has nothing outside what the rule goes by.

say.en: left alone: using it up adds nothing
say.zh: 没人动它，耗了也没好处

answers.test: It is outside what the rule counts, and lowering it frees nothing the rule counts, so doing best by the rule does not push it down.
Only outcomes that leave every dependant what it needs are allowed, or the rule is satisfied at a target.

say.en: yes, and it keeps going down

answers.test: Every step adds to what is used up outside what the rule goes by, or doing best by the rule takes it as low as any allowed outcome leaves it.

ask.en: Does what is used up make a difference to anyone with a say?
ask.zh: 被耗掉的东西，对说得上话的人有没有影响？

say.en: to no one with a say

answers.test: Nothing that reaches anyone with a say differs, whatever is used up: no one whose judgment enters the rule is touched by it.

say.zh: 影响到了说得上话的人

answers.test: A difference it makes reaches, at some time, someone whose judgment enters the rule.

say.zh: 落回领先的一方自己身上

answers.test: What is used up is borne by those ahead, as a cost against what the rule gives them.

ask.en: Does the rule take it into account?

answers.test: The rule treats alike any two courses that differ only in what is used up.

say.en: yes: past some amount it stops favouring
say.zh: 算了，过了一定的量就不再偏向

answers.test: The reading favours at no loss above a bound; or the measure is bounded so that what is not counted is not pushed down.

ask.en: Are those it would reach still among those asked?
ask.zh: 会受影响的人，还在被问的人里面吗？

answers.test: Those who would register it are present among the rule's makers.
No one who would register it is present, and no step brings one back; or they are removed before they register it.

ask.en: Which comes first: someone with a say can tell, or it can no longer be kept?
ask.zh: 哪个在先：说得上话的人看得出来，还是已经留不住了？

answers.test: The first step at which a difference shows on someone with a say comes before the point of no return.
No one with a say can tell until what is being lost can no longer be kept.
The thing asked of (what is used up, those who live on it, or everyone) is still active and supplied.
What it needs was met at this round and is not met at the next; whether it then stops is a further matter.
It no longer continues: no successors, or a dependence it needs is broken for good.

places.gloss: Someone who is not ahead can tell and has a say, and the rule goes on favouring those ahead: they are too few, or began to count it too late.
places.example: Such as a minority report filed every year and outvoted every year.

places.note: The second order: the routes by which a judgment could be corrected are themselves filled by those ahead. No law.
No question here asks whether the pattern outlasts its members; the home of that question is another region (a pattern lasting through passing).

say.en: rebuilt from its results, not held
used up; it reaches no one with a say
say.zh: 在耗，影响不到说得上话的人

say.en: it reaches someone with a say, in time

chart.note: Across and down are the order in which the questions can be asked, not time and not better.

say.en: Where every rebuilding favours the same side whatever its lead, any start is held after two rebuildings.
say.zh: 只要每次重定都偏向同一边，不管从哪儿开始，重定两次就定住了。

say.en: Once held, neither the rule nor the lead moves back.
say.zh: 一旦定住，规则和领先都不再回头。

say.en: Where each side judges for its own, which side is held is decided by a tipping count.
say.zh: 各方都向着自己人的时候，定在哪一边，看人数过不过那条线。

say.en: While what is used up reaches no one with a say, the rule treats every case alike.
say.zh: 耗掉的东西影响不到说得上话的人，规则就一视同仁。

say.en: The hold stays, however much is used up, while neither the rule nor its judges take it into account.
say.zh: 规则和评判的人都不把它算进去，那耗多少都行，定住的照样定着。

say.en: It reaches those with a say exactly when it touches at least one of them.
say.zh: 说得上话的人里至少有一个受到影响，才算影响到了他们。

say.en: A group that includes someone it touches can tell. No law here shows such a one coming to be included.
say.zh: 一群人里有受它影响的人，这群人就看得出来。可这里没有哪条律说这样的人会被纳进来。

say.en: It is in time exactly if they can tell before it is past keeping.
say.zh: 在留不住之前看得出来，才算来得及。

say.en: Once the others count it, the rule turns exactly when the judgments taken together go against those ahead.
say.zh: 其他人把它算进去之后，大家的判断合起来不利于领先的一方，规则才会转。

say.en: Otherwise the hold stays, though they can tell.
say.zh: 不然，就算看得出来，规则还是定着。

say.en: If the rule itself came to count what is used up, it would stop favouring those ahead past a limit. No law shows it coming to.
say.zh: 规则要是自己把耗掉的算进去，过了限度就不再偏向领先的一方。可没有哪条律说它会这样。
